## FreshMart Pull Request Description

### Related Issue / Ticket
- Fixes #
- Jira / Issue Reference: 

---

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 🛠️ Refactoring / Tech Debt (no functional change)
- [ ] 🏗️ Infrastructure / Terraform / CI/CD
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

---

### Affected Monorepo Packages / Services
- [ ] `apps/customer-web`
- [ ] `apps/admin-web`
- [ ] `packages/api-sdk`
- [ ] `packages/design-system`
- [ ] `packages/shared`
- [ ] `services/*` (Backend Lambda Microservices)
- [ ] `terraform/*` (AWS Infrastructure)

---

### Quality Gate Checklist
- [ ] I have executed local linting and typechecking (`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] I have added/updated unit or integration tests (`npm test`).
- [ ] UI Rules Check: I have **NOT** redesigned or overwritten existing production Customer/Admin UI layouts without explicit signoff (per `AGENTS.md`).
- [ ] Infrastructure Check: If Terraform is modified, I have run `terraform fmt` and verified `terraform validate`.
- [ ] All mandatory CI checks pass.
